title: Oral Burden of Sjögren Disease: A Systematic Review and Meta-analysis
html:
Journal of Dental Research, Ahead of Print.
Primary Sjögren disease (pSjD) is associated with a wide range of oral manifestations, including mucosal alterations such as oral ulcers, stomatitis, angular cheilitis, papillary atrophy, and tongue fissuration, as well as oral sequelae of sicca symptoms, ...
